title: You Think Adult Brains Stop Growing, Yet Juggling Builds New Cortex in 90 Days
description:
Doctors swore your adult brain was frozen in stone, unable to grow! Yet three rubber balls grew visible new cortex in ninety days! This is the true story of Bogdan Draganski's Juggling Study. Here is what went wrong with ninety years of dogma.
